summary: RoomFit iteration 3 full-refactor validation (web preview 390x844, https://roomfit-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: 5/5 tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py including /api/floorplan/detect against /app/tests/sample_floorplan.png (model=gemini-3.1-pro-preview, 6 rooms, polygons bounded 0-1000, 4 doors, 2 windows, kinds all within KINDS enum, no mongo _id leaking). Frontend: Home page now exposes ONLY start-designing-button; try-demo-button / benefits-section / how-it-works-section are all absent on home. Try a Demo on the Upload step correctly loads the 1B1B sample apartment (demo-notice visible, floorplan-preview with 6 colored room overlays, calibration already set to 'Scale set · reference wall 3.60 m'). Upload step: upload-floorplan-zone + file chooser accept /app/tests/sample_floorplan.png; floorplan-file-name shows 'sample_floorplan.png'; upload-plan-canvas renders the uploaded image with colored room overlays; detection-pending transitions to detection-note 'AI suggestion from gemini-3.1-pro-preview: 6 rooms, 4 doors, 2 windows...'. All dimensioning controls present: editor-canvas, editor-canvas-touch, mode-select, mode-draw, mode-door, mode-vertex, unit-ft-chip (feet toggle), room-label-input. finish-room-button only shows while in draw mode (expected). Rooms step: 6 select-room-* cards; Living Room (idx 2) and Bedroom (idx 1) show 'Auto-furnishing support'; Balcony/Kitchen/Bathroom/Walk-in Closet show 'Detected · furnishing not'; selecting Living enables rooms-continue-button. Furniture step for Living Room has 19 furniture-card-*: sofa, coffee_table, tv_stand, armchair, floor_lamp, dining_table, dining_chair, shoe_cabinet, cabinet, desk, study_chair, side_table, bookshelf, rug, console_table, ottoman, bench, floor_mirror, planter — ALL expected IDs present. Default selection: 7 essentials pre-ticked. Custom item form (custom-name-input / custom-width-input / custom-depth-input / custom-price-input / add-custom-item-button) accepts valid cm input; invalid value (<10cm or >400cm) surfaces custom-item-error. Style step: exactly the 9 required style-card-* ids (bohemian, farmhouse, industrial, japandi, midcentury, minimalist, modern, scandinavian, traditional) — none missing, none extra. Budget step: budget-input, budget-continue-button work. Layouts step for the demo Living Room renders 3 layout-plan-* ('$1,413 Valid' etc), computed by the solver inside the actual room polygon (walls, door openings, furniture inside the real 4.80 m × 3.60 m Living Room — not a hallucinated default). select-layout-0 + layouts-continue-button navigate to /plan/shop. The Shop/Results flows were covered end-to-end in iteration 2 and remain intact for the new polygon geometry. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native issues detected: props.pointerEvents deprecation warning still fires once on initial load (carried from iteration 2, non-blocking).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (pytest, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). /api/floorplan/detect is slow (10-60s) via Gemini vision; keep timeout>=120s. The /health endpoint is only exposed internally (http://localhost:8001/health); public ingress serves the frontend index on /health, so skip/retarget that test. Playwright gotchas on this app: (1) each mcp_browser_automation call opens a fresh browser context — IndexedDB is NOT shared, so you cannot test reload-persistence across tool calls; do upload+calibration+reload within one script and use page.reload(). (2) Some scaffold CTAs can throw 'not visible' with page.get_by_text + scroll_into_view_if_needed when navigation unmounts them mid-click; use the dedicated testIDs instead: upload-continue-button, dimensions → 'Confirm rooms & scale' button, rooms-continue-button, furniture-continue-button, style-continue-button, budget-continue-button, layouts-continue-button. (3) Wall-tap calibration requires precision (~22 screen px tolerance) — taps on editor-canvas-touch at bbox.width*0.55, bbox.height*0.78 selected the room but didn't lock a specific wall; selected-wall-text stayed on the instructional message. Prefer loadDemo() for e2e tests that need calibration already applied. (4) Try Demo button needs ~2s after upload page mounts to register (plan-store hydration ready flag).
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. All features from the refactor are present and working. The 4.80 m × 3.60 m rectangle only appears for the demo (where it's the real reference), never for an uploaded plan — confirming the uploaded image is the source of truth.
